name: labs/wasatchphotonics__wasatch.py
title: Wasatch Photonics FID spectrometer (wasatch.FeatureIdentificationDevice)
intro: Wasatch Photonics FID spectrometer (wasatch.FeatureIdentificationDevice), adapted from wasatchphotonics/wasatch.py. It reads `detector_temperature_degC`, `detector_tec_setpoint_degC`, `tec_enabled`, `ambient_temperature_degC` and 1 more; sets `integration_time_ms`; runs `acquire_spectrum` and `laser_off`. `acquire_spectrum`: acquire one spectrum with the current integration time. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
